exact_defect_formula: Dbar(M)=M-309 for every integer M>=311; in particular Dbar never equals 1
exact_defect_and_short_tail_frontier.strongest_unconditional_tail: because M and Dbar are finite Borel functions on the finite grouped law, mass{M>m}->0 and mass{Dbar>d}->0 by continuity from above
exact_defect_and_short_tail_frontier.target_physical_tail: mass{M>m}=integral_{M>m}p dlambda<=C_len*2^-m for every integer m>=0

intersection_and_gate_frontier.Borel_same_raw_point_joint_predicate: S_fw(P_fw(y,x)) and S_rev(P_rev(y,x)) can be intersected measurably on m_raw
intersection_and_gate_frontier.reason: the two-proper-view lemma transports integrals, not boundary geometry; a thin overlap can have unbounded normalized Z even when both ambient views are proper

physical_postproperization_W_r_join.per_view_envelope: Round49 gives integral 1_Ssigma*exp(C_sigma_post/4176) d(lambda K_sigma_star)<A_H*integral p dlambda
physical_postproperization_W_r_join.per_view_post_clock: C_sigma_post=H+221328+696*k_sigma on its own proper pushforward view
physical_postproperization_W_r_join.raw_pullback_equivalent: the same W_r is obtained on m_raw by composing each orientation term with P_sigma; both descriptions charge K_par once
physical_postproperization_W_r_join.scope: every fixed |s|<=1/400, finite return depth n, fixed finite terminal schedule, fixed finite terminal time H, and integer r>=1

physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.Borel_isomorphism_reason: Dbar is integer-valued Borel; on each {Dbar=d}, H, I, and every finite regular T_s iterate and inverse are Borel.  Keeping y makes each map injective; Lusin-Souslin gives Borel images and Borel inverses
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.common_raw_record: one Round50 rn-whole-family ID y and one half-open-owned physical source point x; fw/rev partitions sum to this same K_par modulo the frozen null boundary
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.cut_policy: natural/image recuts only label half-open components of the pushforward; they neither duplicate nor normalize physical mass
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.full_measure_regular_domain: remove the stopped-orbit singular preimages in both orientations; their countable Borel union over integer stopping strata is m_raw-null by the collision-SRB null theorem and the exact Round50 outer disintegration, and is assigned to the pre-existing singular cemetery

initial_view_maps.H: T_s^n on one regular component, with a real-analytic inverse on its image
initial_view_maps.V_fw: the forward starting view of the Round35 common physical restriction
initial_view_maps.V_rev: I o H applied to the same source restriction, the reverse starting view I(B)

physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.measure_transport: K_sigma_star(y,.)=(P_sigma(y,.))_#K_par(y,.); hence P_sigma is a measure-space isomorphism modulo its null domain and K_sigma_star(y,X_sigma)=p(y)
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.physical_measure_compatibility: after outer disintegration, H, I, and T_s preserve collision-SRB mass; the pushforward construction additionally gives the fibrewise integral identity by definition
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.proper_view_conclusion: both K_fw_star and K_rev_star are whole proper standard-family kernels after their own 696*Dbar closed evolutions
physical_two_proper_view_object_lemma.raw_finite_law: m_raw(dy,dx)=lambda(dy)K_par(y,dx), with K_par(y,X)=p(y) and integral p dlambda<infinity

provenance.claim_type: physical two-proper-view measure transport, once-charge postproperization W_r join, and exact short-endpoint moment frontier
provenance.depth_scope: every fixed finite first-return depth n

orientation_integral_identities: integral f_rev_star dm_star=integral f_rev(P_rev(y,x)) dm_raw=integral f_rev d(lambda K_rev_star)

short_tail_nonimplication.compatibility_with_current_abstract_fiel: finite total physical mass, standard-Borel countable grouping, finite cells per group, positive lengths, fixed D1 rank density, and recordwise finite J
short_tail_nonimplication.construction: on disjoint b-bands of mass 2^-n, split a unit fibre into 2^(n^2) equal source intervals of length 2^(-n^2), take the reverse view and partition identical to the forward view, and use uniform area density with fixed incidence rank B=14
short_tail_nonimplication.defect_moment_failure: Dbar(n^2)=n^2-309 and 2^-n*(6/5)^Dbar does not tend to zero
short_tail_nonimplication.even_required_exponential_moment_failure: exp(1/6)>7/6, so 2^-n*exp(Dbar/6)>=2^-n*(7/6)^Dbar does not tend to zero
short_tail_nonimplication.linear_tail_consequence: no finite C_len works in this model
short_tail_nonimplication.logical_scope: a nonimplication model for the fields currently certified, not a claim that actual billiard fibres realize this partition
short_tail_nonimplication.natural_recut_scope: for n>=19 these source intervals are shorter than 1e-90, so each is a single clipped endpoint cell; the example does not rely on infinitely many recuts inside one group
short_tail_nonimplication.tail_lower_test: at m=n^2-1, mass{M>m}>=2^-n, so any constant in mass{M>m}<=C_len*2^-m must satisfy C_len>=2^(n^2-n-1)
